{{Quote|Oh, hello, Centada. I'm so glad you could join us tonight.|Baron Yasto Attsmun greets Ressad|<ref name="HNSNSN" />}}
[[Lady]] '''Centada Ressad''' was a wealthy [[Gender|female]] [[Tallimarian]] aristocrat from the [[Ressad Dynasty]] from [[Tallimar Prime]]. During the [[Cold War]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], she was present in [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] and attended a party on the ''[[Undisputed Victor]]'', a [[Yacht (aquatic)|yacht]] owned by [[Baron]] [[Yasto Attsmun]]. At the party she encountered the [[Dor Namethian]] [[Lexo Sooger]], whom she had previously received a massage from at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]]; however, as the masseuse was trying to remain incognito he pretended not to know her. Ressad then spoke with the baron and the [[arms dealer]] [[Jerdon Bly]], the later of whom asked to be left alone with her and began making advances toward her. After he grabbed her and pulled her close, Ressad stamped on his foot and then fled.

==Biography==
[[Lady]] Centada Ressad was a<ref name="HNSNSN" /> [[Currency|wealthy]]<ref name="JoJ" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="HNSNSN" /> [[Tallimarian]] aristocrat from the [[Ressad Dynasty]] from [[Tallimar Prime]],<ref name="JoJ" /> who lived during the [[Cold War]] between the [[Resistance]] and the [[First Order]].<ref name="HNSNSN" /> At some point, Ressad attended a a ball on [[Adikaria]] and was pictured in a news report covering the event.<ref name="JoJ" />

===On Canto Bight===
[[File:Last-jedi-databank-master-codebreaker-cropped.png|thumb|Centada Ressad with the Master Codebreaker at the Canto Casino.|left|239x239px]]
{{Quote|May I steal Lady Ressad away for a while?|Jerdon Bly asks to be left alone with Ressad|<ref name="HNSNSN" />}}
In [[34 ABY]], around the time of the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]],<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/4-reasons-canto-bight-is-an-essential-read|text=4 Reasons ''Canto Bight'' Is an Essential Read}} states that ''[[Canto Bight (novella collection)|Canto Bight]]'' takes place a few [[Standard day|days]] prior to {{Film|VIII}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]], meaning that both ''The Last Jedi'' and ''Canto Bight'' date to 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. ''The Last Jedi'' also takes place shortly after {{Film|VII}}, which features the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]].</ref> Ressad spent time in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. While there, she was a patron of [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]], where she was massaged by the [[Dor Namethian]] [[Lexo Sooger]] on at least one occasion and name dropped the [[Count|Contessa]] [[Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion]] in conversation with him. She later encounter Sooger in Canto Bight again while attending one of [[Baron]] [[Yasto Attsmun]] parties on the his [[Yacht (aquatic)|yacht]], the ''[[Undisputed Victor]]''. Ressad recognized Sooger and approached him, but the masseuse was in disguise as a waiter and trying to remain incognito, as he had been sent by the contessa to [[Death|kill]] the [[arms dealer]] [[Jerdon Bly]]. He pretended not to know Ressad, who then left him to speak to the baron and Bly. The baron made introductions between Ressad and Bly, after which the arms dealer asked to be left alone with her as he was attracted to her. When they were alone he tried to put his [[Limb|arm]] around her waist, but she slipped away from him and avoided it. He then successfully tried again and pulled her close, causing her to stamp down on the insole of his foot. As Bly doubled over in pain, Ressad gracefully glided away from him past other party guests who were gathering round him to check if he was alright. Sooger later called Bly and pretended to be Ressad's personal assistant, claiming she wanted to meet him away from prying eyes in order to lure Bly into a remote part of the yacht. The ploy worked and the Dor Namethian killed Bly and then pretended to have discovered a fire, causing Ressad and the other guests to evacuate the boat.<ref name="HNSNSN" />

Ressad later attended the casino with the [[Master Codebreaker]] and his companion "[[Lovey]]" the night [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|came]] in search of the [[human]] [[slicer]], only to be arrested by [[Canto Bight Police Department|Canto Bight Police]] [[officer]]s.<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|I saw her on a holo once. An old news report about some fancy ball on Adikaria.|Velorie Sarcon speaks about Centada Ressad|audio=Sarcon-Adikaria-JawsOfJakku.flac|<ref name="JoJ" />}}
The orphaned Tallimarian [[scavenger]] [[Velorie Sarcon]] later saw a [[Hologram|holo]] of the news report about Ressad at the ball on Adikaria and Sarcon—who thought the ball looked fancy— began telling others on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]] that she was part of the Ressad Dynasty and that Centada was her aunt and that she would join her some day when she had enough money.<ref name="JoJ" /> Between [[34 ABY]] and [[35 ABY]],<ref name="JoJ-Date">The events of ''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]'' take place between the events of {{Film|VIII}} and {{Film|IX}}, which corresponds to between [[34 ABY]] and [[35 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> Sarcon mentioned Centada Ressad being her aunt to her associates [[Ivrax]] and [[Dex]] while telling them about a scavenging job she had been contracted for, but the two didn't believe her story again and instead mocked Sarcon and questioned why Ressad didn't just sent her the money. After their shared [[Mission to the Explorator|Mission to the ''Explorator'']], Sarcon admitted to her new friend [[Leesa Chaffni]] that she wasn't actually related to Ressad and had only ever seen the report about her. Chaffni later relayed the information to [[Dai's Cafe]] patron [[Naldri Zuvio]] while telling them about her recent adventure.<ref name="JoJ" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You Dor Namethians do look very much alike.|Ressad is confused by Sooger's disguise|<ref name="HNSNSN" />}}
Centada Ressad was a fair-skinned<ref name="TLJVD" /> Tallimarian similar in appearance to a [[human]] but with a cone-shaped head. She had a feminine voice and was considered beautiful by Lexo Sooger, who thought she had lovely [[eye]]s and the softest, smoothest skin he had ever seen. She remembered Sooger after only having met him once or twice despite the fact that he was a member of the serving class, which was unusual among the masseuse's clients. While on the yacht she was afraid of being left alone with Bly and try to politely avoid his advances before hurting him when he went to far so that she could escape.<ref name="HNSNSN" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Centada-Ressad-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 35 by Ivan Manzella]]
Centada Ressad was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]]; however, prior to the film's release<ref name="details">{{SW|url=news/check-out-the-cover-and-new-details-of-journey-to-star-wars-the-last-jedi-canto-bight|text=Check Out the Cover and New Details of Journey to ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' - ''Canto Bight''}}</ref> she appeared in the short story "[[Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing]]," which was written by [[Rae Carson]] and released as part of the [[Canto Bight (novella collection)|''Canto Bight'']] anthology<ref name="HNSNSN" /> on [[December 5]], 2017.<ref name="details" /> Ressad was designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], and her [[species]] was referred to by the production code "King 35."<ref name="TLJ Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], her species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]],<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref> but was identified as Tallimarian in the audio book ''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]],<ref name="JoJ" /> released on [[October 9]] later that same year.<ref name="Audible">{{Audible|domain=co.uk|url=pd/Star-Wars-The-Jaws-of-Jakku-Audiobook/B0DDYZJ3DV|text=Star Wars: The Jaws of Jakku}}</ref>
